nodes.long_description:
1. Tap Practice Shooting to practice shooting
2. Tap Practice Ball Defense and practice ball defense
3. Tap Start Match and select 1 or 2 opponents.
4. Start the match and score 10 points first
nodes.short_description: The Goalball game content lets you play the Paralympic sport of goalball in virtual reality. You will learn the rules of goalball and how to throw and block the ball. The game is designed to help you improve your skills by practicing and mastering it.
